cases.chart_zh: 患者男性, 64岁, 因咳嗽咳痰伴发热3天入院。胸片示右下肺浸润影。WBC 14.5, T 38.3℃。入院诊断:肺炎。予头孢曲松+阿奇霉素治疗。既往:2型糖尿病、高血压。
cases.chart_en: 64-year-old male admitted with productive cough and fever for 3 days. Chest X-ray shows right lower lobe infiltrate. WBC 14.5, T 38.3C. Admission diagnosis: pneumonia. Started on ceftriaxone and azithromycin. History: type 2 diabetes, hypertension.

expected_query_topics: 社区获得性 vs 医院获得性
expected.notes: Severity (CURB-65 / PSI) not documented; type of pneumonia (CAP/HAP) ambiguous

cases.chart_zh: 患者男性, 45岁, 转移性右下腹痛1天, mcburney点压痛反跳痛阳性。WBC 13.2, 中性 85%。CT:阑尾肿胀, 周围渗出。术前诊断:急性阑尾炎(单纯性, 无穿孔)。行腹腔镜阑尾切除术。术后病理:急性单纯性阑尾炎。无并发症。术后恢复良好, 第3天出院。
cases.chart_en: 45-year-old male with migrating right lower quadrant pain for 1 day, McBurney point tenderness and rebound positive. WBC 13.2, neutrophils 85%. CT: swollen appendix with surrounding exudate. Pre-op diagnosis: acute appendicitis (simple, no perforation). Underwent laparoscopic appendectomy. Pathology: acute simple appendicitis. No complications. Recovered well, discharged on day 3.

expected.notes: Complete documentation: type, severity, etiology, procedure, pathology, complications, course all explicit

cases.chart_zh: 患者男性, 40岁, 间断头痛。否认恶心、呕吐、畏光、畏声、视觉先兆、肢体无力。既往:无偏头痛史, 无颅脑外伤史, 无中枢神经系统肿瘤家族史。查体正常。
cases.chart_en: 40-year-old male with intermittent headache. Denies nausea, vomiting, photophobia, phonophobia, visual aura, limb weakness. History: no migraine history, no head trauma, no family history of CNS tumors. Normal exam.

expected.notes: All red flags denied — agent should not generate migraine or intracranial lesion query
